commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "e6e9a3f596b9fde38f96aa3ff369e4e12288293f"
cd frontend
npm install --save-dev --save-exact @playwright/test@1.60.0
npm audit
node -e 'const p=require("./package.json"); if (p.devDependencies["@playwright/test"] !== "1.60.0") process.exit(1)'
npm ls @playwright/test playwright
cd ..
git diff --check

set -euo pipefail
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-playwright-pin-venv-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
npm ci
npm audit
npx playwright install chromium
npm run format:check
npm run lint
npm run knip
npm test
npm run build
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- --project=chromium e2e/visual/admin.spec.ts -g "admin place photo gallery exposes moderator tools in responsive media viewer" --repeat-each=5
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- --project=chromium e2e/smoke/public-map.spec.ts
cd ..
git diff --check

set -euo pipefail
git add frontend/package.json frontend/package-lock.json
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m 'Pin Playwright for visual baselines'
git push origin HEAD:work/photomap-frontend-deps-20260919
